svg.title: CH13 M03 — two separate 3×8 grids numbered audit markup
svg.desc: Baseline preview with numbered callouts mapped one-to-one to audit findings. Production revisions and retained decisions are recorded in the audit.
svg.text: The right grid reuses the left pattern origin x=80 at x=680, a
600 px translation not divisible by 55. It renders nine
unequal columns with partial edge cells.
The result strip has only two solid regions although its
description and brief promise 31 countable cells.
Baseline markup only · See audit for revision targets, acceptance checks, and final resolutions.
